snippet.title: The Black Bass (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Hot B, Sept 1989 (Original Hardware, Composite)
snippet.description:
Black Bass, The was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in September 1989. All audio/visual elements copyright 1989, Hot B. Music composed by ?

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. ABOUT BLACK BASS, THE (NES)

Black Bass is a NES fishing sports game where the player has to catch as many black bass as he can from sunrise to sunset.

AKA: Black Bass 2
